briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensified in Q2 2026 with multiple frontier releases and $11B+ in funding. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate production incidents while regulatory pressure mounts in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2.1T parameters and native multi-agent orchestration. Google deployed Gemini 3 achieving new SOTA on GPQA. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while xAI and DeepSeek launched competing 1T-scale models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 2.4M units shipped. Microsoft and CoreWeave announced $15B joint data center expansion in Texas. TSMC 2nm AI chips entered volume production for Google and Amazon.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10T-parameter model trigger a verifiable intelligence explosion or merely incremental gains?
